notes.title: Update 1.02 - Cleaning Up Bugs!
notes.notes:
Gameplay

- We add an Invite button in lobbies to make joining friends games easier
- Reduced colliders for the human's mouth so it is harder for nuts to win

Bug Fixes

- Fixed the controller sensitivity 
- Updated colliders on the human
- Invested in a dictionary to learn how to spell "dining" correctly
- Reduced the footstep volume because it was way too loud.
- Fixed a weird camera bug that caused the nut's camera to not follow the end of the arc.

notes.title: Update 1.01 - Nut Bots!
notes.notes:
Gameplay

Nut Bots Added - We have decided to implement a Nut Bot AI system so players can add up to 5 Nut Bots into a lobby. This will help fill the void in empty lobbies.

Bug Fixes

-Fixed model spinning too fast
